release.notes: Fix for Hyundai/Kia readings through a BLE ELM327 v1.4 clone (wrong SoC, power, temperatures); 96 more cars get a full profile instead of Generic OBD2; Berlingo/Partner Electric on the i-MiEV profile; BMS remaining energy on Kona/e-Niro/e-Soul/Ioniq; side-menu Demo mode starts the full demo; Car Commands translated into all languages. Cars: BMW cells, Ford hybrids, Nissan Ariya AC charging, Spring/Zoe/smart 12 V, Jaguar coolant, Hongqi, Leapmotor B10.
